entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling because I need to return a helmet I bought. I just feel so bad about it, but I can't keep it.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It’s just... the color. It looked different on the website. I feel terrible, I know it's been a little while since it was delivered. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I was really hoping for some help. I could really use the money back.

I completely understand. Getting the color right is important, and of course, the most crucial thing is that you have gear you feel good about for your safety. Let me just pull up your order information. Can you provide me with the order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the helmet was delivered 46 days ago.
I know, I'm so sorry. I hope that's not a problem. Like I said, the box is unopened, pristine.
It's no problem at all. For standard equipment like this helmet, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that window.
Oh, really? So I can still return it? That is such a relief. I was so worried.

Absolutely. I am processing the return authorization for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Thank you so, so much, Alex. You have no idea how much this helps. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
